description: This file defines the PHP class `Returns` within the namespace `Opencart"Catalog\

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: A model class managing customer return data, including adding new returns, retrieving specific return details, listing multiple returns, counting total returns for a customer, and fetching return histories.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Adds a new return record to the database with provided data and returns the inserted record's ID.

methods.name: getReturn
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific return based on return ID, ensuring it belongs to the current customer.

methods.name: getReturns
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of return summaries for the current customer, filtered by start, limit, and ordered by return ID.

methods.name: getTotalReturns
methods.description: Returns the total number of returns made by the current customer.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves the history entries (comments, statuses, dates) associated with a specific return ID.
